title: Refresh Your Concert Wardrobe With These Nordstrom Anniversary Sale Finds, Starting at $18
summary: From Nirvana and Smashing Pumpkins tees to Adidas and New Balance sneakers, these hidden Nordstrom Anniversary Sale finds are made for your next concert.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The Nordstrom Anniversary Sale is usually where shoppers go for fashion, beauty and designer deals, but there’s a hidden section worth checking out if you’re a music fan. This year, the sale is filled with concert-ready finds, from vintage-inspired band tees and sneakers you can actually wear all day to accessories that complement your concert look.

The biggest surprise? Nordstrom has Nirvana, The Smashing Pumpkins and Johnny Cash tees starting at just $18. The vintage-inspired styles feel like the kind of merch you’d find at a record store or vintage shop, making them an easy way to bring some rock-inspired style into your summer wardrobe.

For anyone planning their next concert or festival outfit, the shoe lineup is just as exciting. Adidas, New Balance and UGG styles are all part of the sale, giving shoppers plenty of comfortable options for long days spent standing, dancing and exploring. Plus, the hidden gems don’t stop at clothing. Nordstrom also has accessories that tap into fan culture, including playful picks Pokémon fans will want to check out.

Nordstrom Anniversary Sale 2026: Best Band Tees Merch Deals

GRUNGE CLASSIC

Nirvana Graphic Print Off the Shoulder Cotton T-Shirt

$18 $24 25% off

Buy now at nordstrom

Nirvana helped define the sound and style of ’90s alternative rock, and the band’s signature graphics remain a favorite among fans.

This graphic-print band tee features a relaxed cotton fit and off-the-shoulder design for a stylish update to traditional merch. Wear it with denim or sneakers for a laid-back look made for concerts and festivals. It’s available in sizes XS to XL.

ALT-ROCK ESSENTIAL

Smashing Pumpkins Graphic T-Shirt

$21.75 $29 25% off

With albums like Siamese Dream and Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness , The Smashing Pumpkins became one of the most influential names in alternative rock.

Made from 100% cotton, this graphic T-shirt comes in a classic crewneck silhouette with a relaxed dropped-shoulder fit. Available in sizes XS-XL and priced under $25, it’s an easy pick for concerts, festivals and music fans.

COUNTRY MUSIC ICON

Johnny Cash Bandana Graphic Tank

Johnny Cash’s “Man in Black” image became one of music’s most recognizable signatures, reflecting his influence across country, rock and Americana.

This graphic tank reimagines his classic imagery in a white cotton-blend silhouette with a scoop neckline and cropped bandana hem. It’s a more unexpected take on band merch for fans looking beyond the standard graphic tee.

METALHEAD MUST-HAVE

Metallica Fire Scull Cotton Graphic T-Shirt

Buy Now on nordstrom

From Master of Puppets to the Black Album era, Metallica has built a legacy as one of heavy metal’s most celebrated bands.

With a price tag of $21.75 and made from 100% cotton, this graphic T-shirt showcases a fiery skull design and oversized fit for a relaxed silhouette. It’s a must-have piece for concerts, festivals and fans of the legendary metal band.

Nordstrom Anniversary Sale 2026: Best Concert Sneaker Deals

FESTIVAL FOOTWEAR FIND

New Balance Gender Inclusive 530 Sneaker

$89.99 $109.99 18% off

When it comes to concert shoes, comfort is key, and the New Balance 530 delivers with a retro runner design built for all-day wear.

This gender-inclusive sneaker combines breathable mesh with ABZORB cushioning to help absorb impact during hours of standing, walking and dancing. It’s an easy pick for festival weekends, live shows and music-filled days.

HIDDEN SALE GEM

Adidas Gazelle Indoor Sneaker

$89.99 $120 25% off

Originally designed as an indoor training sneaker, the adidas Gazelle Indoor has evolved into a street style staple with strong ties to music and culture.

Built for comfort, this sneaker combines a supportive sole with a sleek silhouette that won’t weigh down your concert outfit. It’s an easy pick for festival grounds, standing room shows and exploring between sets.

POST-SHOW PICK

UGG Neuman Slipper

$89.99 $130 31% off

Don’t underestimate a good slipper — UGG’s Neuman proves comfort can still have a place in a concert-ready wardrobe.

The UGG Neuman Slipper combines a soft suede exterior, plush UGGplush lining and durable outsole for a cozy feel that goes beyond traditional slippers. Wear them while getting ready, traveling to a festival or relaxing after a long day of shows.

Nordstrom Anniversary Sale 2026: Best Festival-Ready Accessory Deals

CONCERT COMPANION

Hedgren Nostos Matte Adult Backpack

8.1 inches x 13 inches x 17.3 inches

$92.99 $125 26% off

Small bags may be the standard for many concerts, but all-day festivals and travel-heavy plans often call for something with a little more room.

The Hedgren Nostos Matte Adult Backpack offers a spacious silhouette with smart organization, including a padded laptop compartment, side pockets, concealed zippers and an AirTag holder. Its water-resistant material and cushioned straps make it a comfortable option for carrying everything you need from morning to night.

COLLECTIBLE ACCESSORY

Maison de Sabré The SABRÉMOJI Pokémon Charm

$65.99 $89 26% off

From trading photocards at K-pop shows to collecting Pokémon merchandise, fans have found new ways to turn their favorite interests into wearable accessories.

This SABRÉMOJI Pokémon Charm taps into that collector mindset with full-grain DriTan European leather, handcrafted marquetry details and Apple AirTag compatibility. It’s a stylish way for Pokémon fans, K-pop collectors and concertgoers to personalize their favorite bags.

Nordstrom Anniversary Sale 2026: Best Tech Deal for Streaming Concerts

FESTIVAL WATCH PARTY

Vankyo Native 1080p Wireless LCD Projector

$99.99 $209.99 52% off

Festival tickets aren’t the only way to enjoy a live music experience. The Vankyo Native 1080p Wireless LCD Projector lets you recreate the concert atmosphere from the comfort of your own home.

The Full HD at 1080p projector supports wireless screen mirroring, allowing you to stream content from compatible iOS and Android devices. It also comes with keystone adjustment for an easier setup, 150 lumens for a colorful display and a projector screen to complete your at-home entertainment setup.

If you’re skipping festivals like Coachella , Lollapalooza or Bonnaroo this year, these finds can still help you create your own concert experience from home. From comfortable sneakers made for long days on your feet to band tees and accessories that show off your favorite interests, these Nordstrom Anniversary Sale deals make it easier to build a music-inspired look without overspending. Plus, affordable tech under $100 can help bring the live music atmosphere home, whether you’re hosting friends or enjoying a solo listening session.

The Nordstrom Anniversary Sale 2026 is happening now, with deals across fashion, beauty, accessories and more. For concertgoers looking to refresh their wardrobe, the sale offers a mix of stylish and practical finds, from footwear designed for all-day wear to pieces that can be styled long after the event ends. Nordstrom cardmembers are given early access to the sale, which started Tuesday, July 14. However, the sale is now open to all shoppers until it ends on Sunday, Aug. 9, so now is the time to shop these music-inspired finds before popular styles sell out.
